response.original_title: SHOOT＆TAKUYA in さがみ湖MORI MORI～BUDDiiSコンビの全力レポートSP
response.overview: A special program featuring SHOOT (森愁斗) and TAKUYA (大槻拓也) from the popular dance and vocal group BUDDiiS, as they experience various attractions at 'Sagamiko MORI MORI', a leisure facility in Sagamihara City, Kanagawa Prefecture.
